deploy-platform-images.yml:build-and-pus.authorization: Its publishing steps run only when PUBLISH_IMAGES is true, and its first step then refuses any ref but refs/heads/trunk or a v* tag, compared exactly in shell; publish-manifests needs authorize-publish. Branch scan_only dispatches skip that step and publish nothing; the GHCR login serves only the build cache.
